segments.content:
Unfortunately, before he could devise a countermeasure, that Shangguan Wan'er was actually walking gracefully toward him.

After a moment, Zhang Xiang spoke first: "I just remembered I have some things to do at home, I'll be leaving first!" Without waiting for anyone to ask, he buried his head and rushed into the rain, running in the direction of his home.

The monster remains purchased from His Highness Luo Hao had unexpectedly been auctioned off for a high price of forty thousand gold coins on the main plane of the New Continent, the Roer Continent. After deducting various fees, the profit was actually over twenty thousand.

Madam Shen smiled and nodded. Back when she had just married into the Shen family, her husband had asked her the same thing, and she had replied in the same way, but those were not her true feelings.

"No wonder it's freezing today." Nishio curled himself into a ball. He was not as happy as Takami.

"It shouldn't be. If the White Tiger were really affected, with his temperament, he would have long since unleashed a bloody massacre upon the continent." The Vermilion Bird shook his head, but his eyes were filled with worry.

Luo Hao originally did not want to let him go, but the golden-armored behemoth had already started moving and was a hundred meters away. A moment later, a brilliance flashed across its body, and all its injuries surprisingly vanished.

She summoned her elite guards and hurried to the city walls. Unexpectedly, by the time she arrived, the abyssal monsters were already being picked off one by one by Malawi.

Losing her mother at the age of six, her only memory was of her mother gently calling her name and holding her. She dearly missed the times when she could act spoiled and bargain in her mother's arms.

Yet even so, Ning Yue had already done what he needed to do. Three individuals, two demons and one immortal, were utterly obliterated by Ning Yue with almost no resistance.

According to legend, after a person dies, their soul can still travel to the Underworld, but this journey requires the guidance of Ox-Head and Horse-Face, and it is said to be fraught with peril.

"In that case, we too are curious about the Fifth Prince's future princess!" an Empyrean peak expert from one of the five great imperial clans chimed in.

He flew at extreme speed, which the golden flood dragon naturally couldn't match. In the blink of an eye, Old Zhu was already close to Sha Tong, his Seven Star Spear thrusting straight at Sha Tong's chest.

"Haha… alright, get up. Since you want to be an official, so be it. I will make you an official, but if you make a mistake, I will mete out punishment according to the rules without fail." Liu Yong looked at Kou Feng and smiled.

After Xu Shu read the letter, a glint of light flashed almost imperceptibly in his eyes, but it vanished in an instant, so fast that not even Xiahou Dun noticed.

Fang Yi agreed, and shortly after, a man riding on divine light leaped onto Fang Yi's flying vessel.

"Amitabha." After chanting the Buddha's name, Ye Heluo vanished from the top of the rock and appeared by Dugu's side. Chanting an incantation, a cloud emerged to support the two, heading straight for White Mountain City.

Xiang Hao's expression changed. He felt countless berserk powers within his body, but for some reason, he couldn't perfectly command them. Yet, he had no choice but to deal with the attacks from Situ Yan and the others.

Seeing that things would not go well if this continued, the numerous ghost generals also made their moves, each unleashing their strongest techniques and charging toward Fang Yi.

With a click, after lodging it in the snow, Qin Tao, holding the sniper rifle, charged backward once more.

This damn scout! He cursed viciously. He had thought a mighty army was bearing down, and Edward hadn't even planned to defend the city. A slight resistance followed by a surrender to the army was his intended plan. This sudden appearance of orcs had greatly disrupted his perfect scheme.

Nangong Changyun both saw and heard Yan Lizhi and Min Zetong suddenly disappear, and his heart sank at that moment.

However, thinking about the intensity of the magic he had cast on Fang Li, he decided to find a few higher-level warriors to experiment on. To his frustration, as soon as those warriors heard his request, they would all say the same thing, otherwise, they wouldn't dare to strike him even if it killed them. He reckoned that a few of the warriors probably suspected he had suicidal tendencies.

It wasn't until the Young Master retrieved Liu Ling's recent activity reports and investigated further that the details of the Holy Grail War gradually came to light.

Once she decided not to go, the crown prince of the neighboring country would surely die, and a war would be inevitable.

Along with the wild laughter, blue smoke also wafted out from the house. The smoke was thick as it drifted up toward the sky.

The Kingdom of Bangzi relied on the Meijianli government for too many things. Now was not the time for them to have a falling out with the Meijianli government. At most, they were just using each other.

A hint of dejection suddenly appeared on his originally somewhat excited face. More than half the time had already passed. While it wasn't impossible for him to refine other pills, the amount of time it would waste… Even if he used this time to refine one more, the quality would likely be much worse.

Nangong Changyun thought for a moment. He didn't know what he had gone off to do. Just as everyone was pondering the identity of the person before them, he suddenly appeared. Could it be that he had gone to investigate the situation?

And in ranked matches, the most terrifying is the Starry Brilliance promotion match, because the opponents' skill level is too high.

Because if they were sent back to that broken house by those beastly men, where would Ye Tingchen ever find them?

In fact, after an Eastern martial artist reaches the Grandmaster realm, they are countless times stronger than a Western S-rank mage.

Just as he was repeatedly steeling his resolve and cheering himself on, someone suddenly patted him on the back.

Perhaps it's because when you get busy, so busy that you have to squeeze out time even for a drink of water, a single second of rest becomes incredibly precious.

Fletcher turned his head to look at Canglong, somewhat puzzled as to why this workaholic was appearing here at this time.

Facing Shen Caiyi's comatose state, he was powerless. This feeling was unbearable to him.

Although she was arrogant, her family background was not good, and she couldn't compare to people from wealthy families like Jun Yiru and Yin Muxue. If she were expelled from Z High, what good would her excellent grades be? What high school would accept her?
